title: Chapter 1080
text:
"Hahaha, I've escaped!"

In the space storm that resembled a thundercloud, a green light was floating. It was Traveler, who was wrapped in a magic shield.

At this moment, he was no longer in the crazy mode of Evil Convergence. Although his skin was still pale, the evil aura had disappeared, and his demeanor had returned to normal, leaving only a face full of lingering fear and unwillingness.

In order to ambush Clottey, Traveler had gathered the friends he had made in the secondary dimensions over the years. He had thought that with a total of four Beyond Grade As, they would be able to force the Dark Emperor to retreat with the home field advantage.

However, reality gave him a big slap in the face.

Clottey was too strong. He was a Super High Risk Esper Ability himself, and his large-scale attack power was off the charts. Through the simulation of a miniature universe explosion using dark energy, he overturned the entire secondary dimension of Evil Convergence and broke through the space wall from the inside.

If it was just him being strong, it would have been fine. Although the few Beyond Grade As were no match for him, they still had a chance to escape. However, what made Traveler despair the most was that Clotti had a few Universal Treasures in his hands!

As a direct descendant of the dynasty and the personal guard of the ruler, Clottey never lacked Universal Treasures. Furthermore, he did not need to exchange for them. In order to make it easier for him to carry out missions, the dynasty took the initiative to take out different Universal Treasures from their warehouse for Clottey to use.

During this mission to the secondary dimensions, Clottey had taken out five Universal Treasures from the dynasty's warehouse, which were greatly beneficial to his combat strength. He had gone all out and killed three Beyond Grade As who had not even reached the 52000 Energy Rank limit.

Only Traveler, because of his connection with the secondary dimensions, took advantage of the fact that his wife had exploded and used the invasion of the space turbulence to escape.

With Evil Convergence gone, he would not be able to summon it in the future, causing his combat strength to plummet, and he returned to his original level of Beyond Grade A. His many years of hard work had gone to waste, and he felt extremely pained.

However, this was also a blessing in disguise. The enemy would no longer be able to track him through Evil Convergence. As long as he hid well, he would be safe.

"Being alive means that there is still a chance."

Traveler's heart was filled with the joy of surviving a disaster.

And it wasn't like there was no hope for a comeback …

Traveler lowered his head and opened his palm. An irregularly shaped purple-green fragment lay in the center of his palm. Its texture was like glass.

This was the energy fragment of the Evil Convergence. As long as one used a special method to plant it in a secondary dimension world, there was a chance that a new Evil Convergence would grow. However, it would take a very long time.

"As long as I can avoid the pursuit of the Red Empire and wait for them to give up, I will have ample time to recover my strength. It seems that I will have to hide in the secondary dimensions for decades or even centuries … Fortunately, my lifespan is still very long."

Traveler secretly heaved a sigh of relief. He shook off the haze of failure and pulled himself together again.

After surviving a great calamity, one was bound to have good fortune in the future!

At this moment, within the space storm, three spatial cracks suddenly appeared, leading to unknown secondary dimensions.

Within the Space Storm, encountering a crack in the Space Wall was equivalent to encountering an exit. Otherwise, one would only be lost in the Space Turbulence.

"I didn't expect to reach the exit so quickly. Looks like my luck is about to change." Traveler's eyes lit up. Without hesitation, he chose one of the cracks and flew in.

The next moment, the world in front of him changed. It turned into a secondary dimension riddled with holes. Inside were countless broken black floating islands. It was dead silent.

Traveler passed through the spatial wall and fell into this secondary dimension. Before he could celebrate his escape, he saw a man and a woman in the dimension looking up at him in a daze. They were not wearing mecha helmets.

When he saw the two of them clearly, Traveler's smile froze on his face. He was horrified.

Black Star and the Dragon Emperor!

F * ck, why are the two of them here?

He had just avoided one, and now he had bumped into another one?

Traveler's eyes almost popped out of their sockets. He did not have time to think about the reason. He immediately stopped his falling body and rushed back the way he came, toward the Space Turbulence above.

"Don't run!" Ames reacted immediately. She reached out and pulled. A powerful force field grabbed Traveler's escaping body and pulled him toward her.

Traveler was already heavily injured. Furthermore, he had lost the Evil Convergence and suffered a backlash. He was in a terrible state and could not break free from Ames' force field.

"I can't fall here!" Traveler gritted his teeth. He ignored the consequences and used a secret technique to stimulate his tired mind. He circulated his magic power at a high speed and quickly cast a spell.

The prototype of a teleportation door quickly took shape beside him.

However, before he could complete the spell, a sudden confinement force field interrupted his spell.

Below, Ames's usually lazy eyes suddenly became sharp. She stared at Traveler from afar. A circle of force field rippled out from her forehead.

Hum!

Force Field: Gaze of the Dragon!

Traveler's body froze in midair!

Before he could react, his vision blurred. Ames appeared in front of him through Void Travel. She raised her hand and gently pressed it on his head.

The next moment, a violent force field gushed out from Ames' palm and entered Traveler's body.

Force Field Stress Tear!

The force field in Traveler's body suddenly pulled in all directions, forming countless forces that interacted with each other.

Crack! Crack!

Countless bones and tendons in Traveler's body were being torn apart. Intense pain exploded, engulfing every single one of his nerves. He could not control his twisted expression from the pain.

Poof!

Flowers of blood exploded from every part of Traveler's body. He was dyed red. He opened his mouth and screamed in pain.

His already serious injuries immediately worsened.

At this moment, Ames's eyes shone with a cold light. She raised one leg high. The highly concentrated force field condensed into an extremely sharp cutting force on her leg. She slashed down.

Force Field: Dragon Axe!

Whoosh!

Ames's long leg slashed into Traveler's right shoulder. Like a hot knife cutting through butter, Traveler's arm was chopped off!

She did not give Traveler any chance to fight back. She stepped on Traveler's neck and landed on a broken black floating island below. She stepped on the dying Traveler with her feet.

At this moment, Han Xiao flew over casually. He looked at Ames in surprise.

"Why are you suddenly so violent? It's not like you."

Ames did not look back. She just stared at Traveler under her feet and said calmly, "When Hella was being attacked, he came to attack the Black Star Palace. At that time, I did not understand. Later, I guessed that he wanted to lure your Lord's Avatar out to share your energy in saving Hella. However, you had the foresight to ask me to guard the Black Star Palace. That was why he did not succeed."

Facing Traveler, Ames did not show any mercy. Not only was he in cahoots with the enemies who wanted to kill Hella, but it was also because these people had forced Han Xiao to pay the price of burning his potential. In her opinion, Han Xiao did not say anything about this because he did not want Hella to feel guilty. Ames understood Han Xiao's actions, but she would not really forget and would always keep this matter in her heart.

This trip to the secondary dimensions was mainly to accompany Han Xiao to relax (in her opinion), but she also had the intention of getting even with Traveler.

At this moment, both old and new hatred erupted. Ames did not hesitate at all.

Han Xiao clicked his tongue, squatted down, and looked at the seriously injured Traveler.

"Oh, what day is it today? My luck is so good. I originally wanted to get even with you, but I didn't expect you to come to me yourself."

Traveler's face turned red, and his veins popped out. He was full of grievance and resentment.

He had finally escaped from the clutches of the Dark Emperor, but now he had bumped into the muzzle of Black Star.

He had just escaped the tiger's den, but now he had entered the wolf's den!

Traveler's mood had fluctuated greatly. He was now completely dispirited and did not even have the energy to scold fate for being unfair.

His luck was not on his side. He had nothing to say and could only sigh in his heart.

'This is fate! The heavens want me dead!'

Han Xiao looked at the injuries on Traveler's body caused by the Dark Emperor and asked curiously, "Who did you meet to be so seriously injured?"

Traveler did not say anything. He looked like he was ready to die. When his mind was not affected by Evil Convergence, he was quite normal. Since he knew that there was no way he could survive, he would not beg for mercy.

"Oh, you have quite a backbone."

Han Xiao rolled his eyes and chuckled softly. "I just don't know how the Star Arc Civilization will react if you die. You don't have to deny it. Since I can accurately name the civilization you work for, I naturally have solid evidence."

As soon as he finished speaking, Traveler's expression suddenly changed. He looked at Han Xiao in disbelief.

When he was active in the outside world, he always disguised himself as a neutral and accepted employment from different civilizations to hide the fact that he belonged to a certain Supercluster civilization. His true identity had always been his secret, and the Star Arc Civilization was the Supercluster civilization that he secretly worked for. The outside world did not know about this.

This way, no matter what he did, it would not implicate the civilization. This was also why he could do whatever he wanted without worry.

But now, the identity that he had been hiding was suddenly exposed by Han Xiao. Traveler was shocked, and his mind was in chaos.

He subconsciously wanted to deny it, but judging from Han Xiao's confident expression and tone, he clearly had the evidence and was not lying to him.

"Why … why did you …"

"Why would I know?"

Han Xiao continued the conversation with a mischievous smile on his face as he jokingly said, "You're right.

"Sorokin told me all this."

He was just used to pushing the blame, but Traveler's reaction was beyond his expectations.

"It really is him!" Traveler clenched his teeth. "He noticed the flaw. The upper echelons shouldn't have worked with him!"

Hmm? Is Sorokin really involved in this? Han Xiao was stunned for a moment.

He had thought that the Supercluster civilization was acting on their own and wanted to intensify the conflict between the three Universal Civilizations. He did not know that Traveler's attack on Black Star Palace really had something to do with Sorokin.

He seemed to have accidentally discovered some interesting inside information …

Han Xiaoxin thought quickly, but his expression did not change. He smiled and said, "Since I know who you are, you'd better tell me what happened. Otherwise, you know the consequences. You'll be blamed on the Star Arc Civilization, and I might be able to help you."

If Traveler was alone, he would have been willing to sacrifice himself. However, according to the information in Han Xiao's previous life, Traveler was extremely loyal to the Star Arc Civilization. Now that he had exposed himself, Han Xiao had a hold on him.

Furthermore, Traveler hated Sorokin for telling this to Black Star, and he was worried that he would tell more people. Therefore, he decided to tell the truth about Sorokin's cooperation agreement.

This was not only a compromise but also an attempt to use this method to make Black Star hate Sorokin. He might be able to get rid of Sorokin with a borrowed knife.

Traveler explained everything in detail. Only then did Han Xiao understand what was going on. His eyes sparkled, and he stroked his chin as he muttered to himself, "What's going on?

"Sorokin … So, the one who persuaded the Supercluster Alliance was you. You're the one who wanted to take advantage of the situation, and you're standing on the opposite side of the Beyond Grade As …"

Connecting the information exposed by Traveler and the limited information in his previous life, Han Xiao sneered and roughly understood Sorokin's true intentions.

What maintaining the balance of the universe? What Beyond Grade As should know how to be content with what they have? What standing on the side of the group? These were all bullsh * t.

There were two ways to go up. One was to develop oneself to a higher level, and the other was to reduce the number of competitors. Sorokin was the latter. The way Han Xiao saw it, this guy wanted the entire universe to only have a single digit number of Beyond Grade As. He just wanted to monopolize all the privileges.

The fewer high-level combatants there were, the less of an obstacle he would have. Therefore, it was only natural that he wanted to reduce the number of Beyond Grade As. Therefore, he used the faction differences set up by the advanced civilizations to provoke a conflict between Beyond Grade As.

Han Xiao had actually been wary of Sorokin all this time, but he could not figure out what he was planning. Now that he knew what Sorokin's goal was, it was equivalent to exposing a strong enemy hiding in the dark. He would be able to make targeted preparations in the future. Thinking of this, he felt much more relaxed.

Putting away these plans, Han Xiao pointed at Traveler's wound and asked, "Then, what's with your wound? Who's chasing you?"

Traveler glared at Han Xiao with grief and anger, clenched his teeth, and said, "It's your Red Empire's Dark Emperor!"

"Hmm, he's here too?"

Han Xiao was surprised. Thinking of the information about the Dark Emperor leaving his position as the Ruler's personal guard, he suddenly understood.

It seemed like the Dynasty Ruler was dissatisfied with the cooperation between Radiance and Ethereal again, plus the problem of the Flickering World and the Evolutionary Totem, so he wanted to show off his strength in terms of high-level combatants. Therefore, he sent the Dark Emperor out to chase after the enemy as a warning to organizations with bad intentions. Speaking of which, for a peak Beyond Grade A like the Dark Emperor, the position of personal guard was actually a shackle.

Hearing that Clottey had easily dealt with Traveler's ambush, Han Xiao could not help but praise him in his mind.

As expected of a member of the three Universal Civilizations' trump card, the 'Shadow Director' team.

Han Xiao thought for a while, activated the King mechanical suit's communication system, found the Red Empire's Outpost Station A000, and dialed it.

The secondary dimensions were not like the main universe. There was no quantum network coverage, and many places were without signal. However, Han Xiao had his own quantum base station, and the secondary dimension mechanical suit Clottey was wearing was a special model for the dynasty. It was equipped with a special directional communication device that could contact the dynasty's outpost to prevent him from going missing. Therefore, Han Xiao directly called the dynasty's base in the secondary dimensions and used it as a relay to connect to Clottey.

Because Traveler was the Dark Emperor's mission target, Han Xiao felt that it was necessary to inform Clottey. Otherwise, he would mistakenly think that Traveler had escaped and would have to waste energy in the secondary dimensions to look for him.

After waiting for a while, the communication was finally connected. Clottey's remote projection appeared in front of him, and he was frowning.

"Black Star? Why are you looking for me? "

They were both Pillars of the Empire, but due to the difference in their roles and identities, their communication had been very limited over the past few decades. Their relationship was average, and they did not have any other friendship. Their interactions were limited to colleagues at work.

"Traveler is with me, and I caught him …"

Han Xiao briefly explained the situation.

After listening, Clottey replied concisely, "I'll go over immediately to confirm it with my own eyes."

"Okay." Han Xiao paused for a moment before sending the coordinates to the Dark Emperor.

Clottey nodded and said slowly, "Oh right, when Traveler escaped, he took away an origin energy fragment of Evil Convergence. Look carefully, it should still be in his hands."

After that, his remote projection disappeared, and he hung up the communication. He had no intention of chatting.

"So cold." Han Xiao muttered before turning to look at Traveler. He stretched out his hand and said, "Take out the origin energy fragment."

Traveler gritted his teeth and reluctantly took out the origin energy fragment of Evil Convergence. It was as if he was handing over his wife, and his face turned green.

Han Xiao took it and played with it in his hand.

This was the key to Traveler's Evil Convergence. Just like the wick of the Shadow Lantern, it used the origin energy fragment as a medium to unleash the special energy of the secondary dimension.

Unfortunately, Evil Convergence was gone, and this origin energy fragment could only be used as a tinder. However, when he thought of Traveler's frenzied state after being possessed, he did not intend to become the groom of Evil Convergence.

Han Xiao put away this spoil of war and secretly thought about how to deal with Traveler.

According to his plan, it would be best to seal him in the Spacetime Amber. However, the Dark Emperor's mission was to kill him, and Ames did not seem to want to give up.

Buzz!

Just as he was thinking, the senses of the three of them moved at the same time. They sensed an unfamiliar signal.

The three of them turned their heads at the same time and saw the space wall in the distance open and spit out a small fleet.

Before the three of them had time to wonder, the fleet quickly identified their location and charged toward the three of them. It was clear that they did not come with good intentions.

In the command room of the main ship, Law stared at the confused Han Xiao on the screen and said in a deep voice, "This time, we're right.

"There's no mistake this time. It's Black Star! All ships, lock onto the target and prepare to fire! "
